name: Momoishi Moka
source:
A member of the 8th Training School. She is not under the teachings of Souga, but rather a User assigned as a security guard using a system through her rare ability.
Her ability is not meant for combat, but she is still the second most powerful person in the Training School, under Souga. She also takes on a leadership role like Souga.
Being a calm, gentle person, she almost never feels a sense of tension, even in combat. To make the most of her ability, she spends most of her time on the rooftop.
